verdict.rationale: Pilot is an accounting and bookkeeping service, so posting manual journal entries is a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence shows Pilot offering a way for an accountant to post balanced journal entries with memos. Its evidence covers done-for-you bookkeeping, a communication portal and keeping an existing QuickBooks account; any journal-entry features in QuickBooks belong to the host platform, not Pilot.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can post manual journal entries with balanced debits, credits, and supporting memos
